entries.1b47482e68e60b94: Students from elementary school to high school
entries.356773322bc172bb: Cram schools that introduce video lesson content
entries.42aad31120144f42: A holding company engaged in an educational services business that operates cram schools such as "Ichishin Gakuin," and a nursing care and welfare services business.
entries.4ee2dd02ae8656b2: In addition to cram schools for pupils from elementary school to high school, including “Ichishin Gakuin”, “Kotaro Juku” and “Ibarashin”, it operates the elementary school entrance exam preparation school “Tōkyō Gakuen”, the after-school care service “Nanakara” and the Japanese-language school “Edo Culture Center”, and provides total support for cram school operations through the video lesson content “Wingnet”, among others. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥15,614 million, the largest of the two businesses.
entries.66e164750f4de202: It operates a range of nursing care services, including home-visit care, home care support, day services, group homes for people with dementia, small-scale multifunctional home care, comprehensive support for persons with disabilities, paid nursing homes and nursing care training.
entries.9ae0276ae1af380a: It is a holding company headquartered in Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture, and is composed of the company, 24 consolidated subsidiaries and two equity-method affiliates. The parent company, Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd., holds 49.7% of the voting rights (as of February 28, 2026). In the fiscal year ended February 2026, consolidated employees numbered 924, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
